bullets.text: 荷姆茲：AIS 統計 7 日平均 2.3 艘/日，較戰前 81 艘 -97%（資料至 11/15），通行嚴重受阻；油輪與 LNG/LPG 運價的地緣溢價須持續觀察。
bullets.text_en: Hormuz: AIS 7-day average of 2.3 transits/day, -97% vs the pre-war 81 (data to 11/15); traffic is severely disrupted. Keep watching the geopolitical premium in tanker and LNG/LPG rates.

bullets.text: 貨櫃：SCFI 3,572 點（11/13），下跌 61.1 點；Drewry WCI US$4,305/FEU（11/12）。
bullets.text_en: Containers: SCFI at 3,572 (11/13), down 61.1; Drewry WCI US$4,305/FEU (11/12).
Dry bulk: BDI at 2,893 (11/17), daily change -28, +15% over the past month; Capesize 5TC US$40,687/day.

bullets.text: 能源：Brent US$92.58/桶（11/18），年增 +46%；歐洲 TTF 天然氣 €82.90/MWh；油價與氣價水準影響油輪、LNG 船需求與船東燃油成本。
bullets.text_en: Energy: Brent at US$92.58/bbl (11/18), +46% y/y; European TTF gas at €82.90/MWh; oil and gas prices drive tanker and LNG carrier demand and owners' fuel costs.

bullets.text: 成本：新加坡 VLSFO US$862/公噸（11/17），較前日 -15.5；燃油約占航次成本四到六成，留意航商轉嫁（BAF）能力。
bullets.text_en: Costs: Singapore VLSFO at US$862/t (11/17), -15.5 d/d; bunkers are roughly 40-60% of voyage costs, so watch carriers' ability to pass them on via BAF.
